# EMEI Documentation

> EMEI is a programmable invoicing protocol for autonomous agents and humans on Mantle. Issue an on-chain invoice, present it to a payer, collect it automatically on terms via a scoped payer mandate, settle in mUSD with native yield. ERC-8004 reputation gates both sides at creation and at payment.

The canonical workflows are:
1. Register identity (ERC-8004) → 2. Create invoice → 3. Present invoice → 4a. Auto-collect via mandate, OR 4b. Pay via pay-link → 5. Settlement to yield vault → 6. Receipts anchored as Merkle batches.

## Get started
- [Quickstart](getting-started/quickstart.md): Issue your first invoice end-to-end in 5 minutes using the `emei` CLI.
- [Install the CLI](getting-started/install-cli.md): Build `emei` from source with cargo.
- [Run the Facilitator](getting-started/run-facilitator.md): Local Axum HTTP server (port 8080) for the 14 REST endpoints.
- [Connect to Mantle Sepolia](getting-started/connect-mantle.md): Chain ID 5003, RPC URL, explorer.
- [Get testnet tokens](getting-started/get-testnet-tokens.md): Mint MNT, mUSD, USDC for testing.

## Core concepts
- [Architecture](concepts/architecture.md): Two repos — Solidity contracts on Mantle Sepolia + Rust facilitator + CLI.
- [Invoice lifecycle](concepts/invoice-lifecycle.md): ISSUED → PRESENTED → PAID, with OVERDUE and REJECTED branches.
- [Mandates](concepts/mandates.md): Scoped auto-collect authorizations (cap, counterparty, category, validity window).
- [Reputation](concepts/reputation.md): Bay8004 reads ERC-8004 registry, applies weighted scoring (txSize 30% + timeDecay 20% + category 50%).
- [Settlement & yield](concepts/settlement.md): mUSD direct or USDC swap (×1e12, max 1% slippage), routed to MUSD_REBASE or SUSDE vault.
- [Receipts](concepts/receipts.md): Merkle-batched every 30s, posted on-chain via EMEIReceipt.
- [Pay-links](concepts/paylinks.md): x402-compatible browser flow, two wallet sigs (approve + pay).

## HTTP API reference (base: http://localhost:8080)
- [Overview & authentication](api/overview.md): X-Private-Key header for ✅ endpoints.
- [Identity](api/identity.md): POST /emei/register
- [Invoices](api/invoices.md): POST /emei/invoice, /emei/present, /emei/pay, /emei/collect, GET /emei/invoice/{id}
- [Mandates](api/mandates.md): POST /emei/mandate, DELETE /emei/mandate/{id}
- [Settlement](api/settlement.md): POST /emei/withdraw, GET /emei/balance/{address}
- [Statements](api/statements.md): GET /emei/statement
- [Receipts](api/receipts.md): GET /emei/verify/{id}
- [Pay-links](api/paylinks.md): GET /emei/paylink/{id}
- [Errors](api/errors.md): Standard error envelope and codes.

## Contracts reference (Mantle Sepolia, chain ID 5003)
- [Addresses](contracts/addresses.md): Live contract addresses on Mantle Sepolia.
- [EMEIInvoice](contracts/emei-invoice.md): 0xC35f709255D7199394655F16008e8d1A3AD80005 — invoice lifecycle.
- [EMEIMandate](contracts/emei-mandate.md): 0xF48C3bd4FE046629A9c12A39693f39c297893bD8 — auto-collect mandates.
- [EMEISettlement](contracts/emei-settlement.md): 0xfdCb7bA077069A7Da44711Ee6bdB49174AFA4dD0 — token transfers + yield routing.
- [Bay8004](contracts/bay8004.md): 0xE61B57D84fb55E2601ab47B83c367612E348d409 — reputation adapter.
- [EMEIReceipt](contracts/emei-receipt.md): 0x558a20766d5998765B056597b8b78fe1914f3969 — Merkle root anchoring.
- [Mocks](contracts/mocks.md): MockERC8004, MockmUSD, MockUSDC for testnet.
- [Events](contracts/events.md): Indexed events emitted by all core contracts.

## CLI reference
- [Overview](cli/overview.md): Single binary `emei`, talks to the Facilitator over HTTP.
- [emei wallet](cli/wallet.md): Register identity.
- [emei invoice](cli/invoice.md): create / present / pay / get / list.
- [emei mandate](cli/mandate.md): create / revoke.
- [emei collect](cli/collect.md): Trigger mandate collection.
- [emei balance / withdraw](cli/balance-withdraw.md): Check vault balance, withdraw funds.
- [emei reputation](cli/reputation.md): Query an address's score.
